summary_en: ¥650M upper limit, 400,000 shares (3.0% of shares outstanding), ¥1,625–¥1,750 price range implied, open-market purchases, execution window 9 June 2026–31 October 2026, flexible capital allocation in response to operating environment.
title_en: Notice Regarding Decision on Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: Gakujo Co. Ltd. (TSE Prime, ticker 2301) approved a share repurchase program on 8 June 2026. The company will acquire up to 400,000 shares of its own ordinary stock (3.0% of shares outstanding, calculated as 400,000 ÷ 13,432,265) for a maximum yen outlay of ¥650 million. Purchases will be conducted via open-market transactions on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between 9 June 2026 and 31 October 2026. The stated rationale is to execute flexible capital allocation in response to changes in the operating environment. At announcement, the company held 2,127,735 treasury shares against a public float of 13,432,265 shares.
